test_Reward_equal: test that a Reward instance equals its deep copy and its string name
test_Reward_not_equal: test that two Reward instances with different names are not equal
create_Reward_instance: create a Reward instance with name, observation spaces, min, max, and threshold parameters
test_Reward_equality_with_string: test that a Reward instance compares equal to its name string
test_Reward_inequality_with_string: test that a Reward instance compares not equal to a different string name
